hook: Lithium niobate chips modulate 493 nm light beyond 50 GHz, with 2.9 dB/cm loss.
summary: The team built a thin-film lithium niobate chip for blue light with couplers, splitters, rings and modulators, aimed at trapped-ion control. Modulators reach over 20 dB extinction and ring resonators show 2.9 dB/cm loss. Photorefraction and substrate uniformity remain unsolved obstacles to scaling.
title: Thin-film lithium niobate integrated photonics at 493 nm
